name: Agility Engineering & Manufacturing Solutions
old_description: For the Agility EMS team, HEART is at the center of every client relationship. When you partner with us, you can expect Honest communication, a commitment to innovation that empowers us to Evolve, and an Accountable team that treats all stakeholders with Respect and uses Teamwork to find lasting solutions. These values have helped Agility EMS serve thousands of customers since 1952.
about:
Agility Engineering & Manufacturing Solutions, based in St. Paul, Minnesota, traces its roots to 1952. The company operates as a 100% employee-owned organization, a structure that aligns incentives across its workforce and reinforces a culture of accountability. While the founders are not named in public records, the business has maintained continuous operation for over seven decades, evolving from a component supplier into a full-spectrum electromechanical partner.

The firm provides distribution, custom manufacturing, and engineering services for electromechanical components. Its capabilities span supply chain management, component repackaging (certified under CSA 238922 and UL TEOU2), wire harness assembly (UL ZPFW2), and UL 508 control panel fabrication (UL NITW7). Engineering support covers the product life cycle from design consultation through end-of-life management, allowing customers to consolidate vendors for both off-the-shelf and custom-built assemblies.

Agility serves original equipment manufacturers in agriculture, medical devices, and IoT infrastructure. Examples include mobility controls for farm machinery, sensing equipment for hospital-grade instruments, and assemblies that support connected IoT networks. The customer base ranges from industrial OEMs to specialized medical equipment makers who require certified components and responsive engineering collaboration.

The company emphasizes its HEART values — Honest communication, Evolution through innovation, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork — as the foundation of client relationships. It differentiates itself through employee ownership, which it says drives flexibility and speed, and through the ability to deliver both distribution and custom solutions under one roof, reducing lead times and coordination overhead.
